timing_forecast.limitations: Heuristic T~1/error^2 scaling of actual 64-core wall times, not a completion deadline or a confidence interval. Rare S runs dominate the mean. Export, training and archive costs do not scale identically; storage estimate also excludes generated process files and reductions. Grid adaptation, cancellations and tails can change scaling.
